title: Rav Yosef bar Manyumi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was a disciple of Rav Nachman, as in [Ketubot 100b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.100b.14), where he said, “It was explained to me by Rav Nachman himself.” We repeatedly find Rav Yosef bar Manyumi speaking in the name of Rav Nachman, as in [Berakhot 23a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.23a.16); Eruvin 45 and 76b; [Yevamot 101b:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.101b.9) and 106b; [Ketubot 81b:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.81b.11); [Gittin 9a:2-3](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.9a.2-3), 45b and 70b; [Bava Kamma 97a:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.97a.7); Bava Metzia 15b in Hyman’s citation (compare [Bava Metzia 16b:19](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.16b.19)), 32a and 64b; [Bava Batra 132a:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.132a.7), 145a, 148b and 159a; Shevuot 47; and [Chullin 13b:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.13b.5), 46a and 48a.[^1][^4]

We also find Rav Yosef bar Manyumi saying, “Rav Sheshet said,” in [Gittin 71a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.71a.8); and Rav Manyumi son of Rav Nachumi said it in his name, as in [Ketubot 81b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.81b.8-11).[^2]

notes.text: Hyman gives Eruvin 45 and Shevuot 47 without an a/b marker.
The antecedent of ‘in his name’ is unstated.

[Heilprin’s parallel entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2016&lang=en) also lists rulings Rav Yosef bar Manyumi transmits in the name of Rav Nachman. Many references overlap, but the lists differ in some locators, including Yevamot 107b in Heilprin and 106b in Hyman.

In Ketubot, Rav Manyumi son of Rav Nachumi transmits Rav Yosef bar Manyumi’s report in Rav Nachman’s name. The consulted Bava Metzia passage names Rav Yosef bar Manyumi and Rav Nachman at the end of 16b and continues at [Bava Metzia 17a:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.17a.1) with the debtor’s claim of repayment.
